Related: #53 (AGENTS.md) and #54 (skills) share the task-rewriting hook and the built-in context extension.

' >> agents.md; gh issue edit 54 --body-file skills.md >/dev/null && gh issue edit 52 --body-file prompts.md >/dev/null && gh issue edit 53 --body-file agents.md >/dev/null && echo ok; git status --short
